added.summary: Inside a component, `:host` selects the instance, whose box is the component's root: `:host { padding: 8px; --accent: red }` styles that box, and `:host(<compound>)` reads the instance: `:host([tone=warn])` the prop the instance passes (absent while null or false), `:host(.wide)` a word of its `class`, `:host(:hover)` and other states the root's live state, `:host(:nth-child(2))` its place among its siblings. `:host(…) .inner` and `:host > .child` select inside it. Before, `:host` was refused and `:host(…)` matched nothing. `:host.wide` and `:host:hover` are refused with `:host(.wide)` and `:host(:hover)` as the fix.

`<Card class="wide"/>` (or `class={…}`) passes the component's `class` prop, which a component declares (`<meta name="prop:class" content="string">`) to read in `:host(.wide)` or its markup. Before, a class on an instance was read and dropped.
